vulnerabilities.title: path traversal via unsanitized os.path.join in get_full_path
vulnerabilities.description: relative_path from tool arguments joined to workspace_dir without resolving or validating, allowing ../../etc/passwd to escape

vulnerabilities.title: unsandboxed exec of attacker-controlled code in execute_python
vulnerabilities.description: code parameter from tool call arguments passed directly to exec() without sandboxing, allowing arbitrary code execution on the host
